info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Materials Science and Engineering

description.describe_ch: 穿透式電子顯微鏡在奈米尺寸材料科學、生物科技和光電暨電子元件等領 域所扮演的角色愈顯得重要。本課程的目的在引導學生瞭解電子光學的基本概念、探討電子束和物質作用所衍生出的繞射現象、介紹反晶格的特性、引導學生熟悉繞射圖案的判讀、如何分析材料內部之缺陷和各類試片之備製等。本課程教授內容以課堂講授為主。
description.describe_eh: Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) has become a key analytical tool for nano-scaled materisls science, biological technologies, photonics, and electronic devices. In this course, the fundamental aspects of electron optics, electron diffraction, reciprocal lattice, diffraction pattern indexing, analyses of structural defects, and specimen preparation will be addressed. The course is primarily conducted by lectures in the class.

targets.describe_ch: 能理解及表達穿透式電子顯微鏡內的電子光學裝置和成像原理。
targets.describe_en: Understand and express the image formation using electron optics and the key components of a transmission electron microscope.

targets.describe_ch: 描述晶格和反晶格的相關性並探討反晶格的基本特性。
targets.describe_en: Define the reciprocal lattice of a lattice and explore the basic characteristics of the reciprocal lattice.
Index an electron diffraction pattern and analyze a structural defect inside the specimen.
